title: Cognite Moves Global Headquarters to Tempe, Bringing Over 100 New Tech Jobs to the Area - NewsBreak
text:
1 hours ago Cognite has relocated its global headquarters to Tempe, Arizona. The company marked the opening of its new facility with an event attended by state officials and business leaders. Arizona is attracting more technology companies, according to local officials.
Governor Katie Hobbs said Cognite’s move will support Arizona’s technology sector and create over 100 jobs in the Phoenix area. These jobs will include roles in AI, software engineering, marketing, sales, and corporate functions.
Cognite CEO Girish Rishi said Arizona’s technology sector, workforce, and location influenced the decision. The company expects to recruit talent in AI, cloud computing, data, and industrial engineering, helped by the presence of major universities. Some senior leaders have moved from Norway to Arizona to support the transition.
Sandra Watson, President and CEO of the Arizona Commerce Authority, said Cognite’s move will add to the state’s technology industry. Christine Mackay, President and CEO of the Greater Phoenix Economic Council, said Cognite will benefit from the local workforce, Arizona State University, and the business environment.
Tempe Mayor Corey Woods welcomed Cognite, citing the city’s technology sector and access to skilled workers. He said the company’s presence could have a positive effect on the local economy and technology industry. Cognite’s new headquarters will allow the company to serve its industrial clients in North America. The move is also expected to support collaboration with partners and advance the company’s work in AI and data-driven technology.
